chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from the one who mentioned it, from Muhammad ibn Suleiman, from Abdullah ibn Latif al-Taflisi, from Razin, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: When Al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him) was struck with the sword, his head fell, then they began to cut off his head. A caller called out from the middle of the Throne: 'Indeed! O you confused community, the strayed ones after their Prophet! May Allah not grant you success for Eid al-Adha nor for Eid al-Fitr.'

He said, then Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'So, by Allah, there is no doubt that they were not granted success, nor will they be granted success until the avenger of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) takes revenge.'

key_terms.فِطْرٍ: Eid al-Fitr (Festival of Breaking the Fast)

ai.seo_question: What did the caller from the Throne say about the community after the death of Imam Al-Husayn?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi highlights the divine judgment on the Umayyad community following the martyrdom of Imam Al-Husayn (AS), linking their spiritual failure to the delay in Qa'im al-Husayn's appearance. The proclamation from beneath the Throne emphasizes that their ritual successes in Eid al-Adha and Eid al-Fitr were hollow until the avenger of his blood arose, a concept central to Shia eschatology regarding the Mahdi.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from the one who mentioned it, from Muhammad Bin Suleyment, from Abdullah Bin Lateef Al Tafleesy, from Razeyn who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When Al-Husayn Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup> was struck with the sword, so his<sup>asws</sup> head fell, so they began to cut off his<sup>asws</sup> head, a Caller called out from the middle of the Throne: ‘Indeed! O you confused community, the Strayed ones after its Prophet<sup>saww</sup>! Allah<sup>azwj</sup> will neither Let you be harmonised for (Eid) Al-Azha nor (Eid) Al-Fitr’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘Then Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So, there is no doubt, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! They are not harmonised, nor would they be harmonising until He<sup>azwj</sup> Avenges the revenge of Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from those whom he has mentioned from Muhammad ibn Sulayman from ‘Abd Allah ibn Latif al- Taflisiy from Zurarah who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘When al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, was hit with the sword and his head fell, he (the killer) rushed to cut off his head, and an announcer announced from the depth of the Throne, “O straying nation in confusion after its prophet, Allah will not unite you in al-Adha’ and al-Fitr ‘Id?”

He (the narrator) has said that abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, then said, ‘Thereafter, by Allah, they did not unite and will not unite until justice about the case of murdering al- Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, is done?”
